description: Source code for Redis's slowlog module, implementing slow query logging, including creation, freeing, initialization, pushing, resetting, and command handling functions.

methods.name: slowlogCreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new slowlog entry with command arguments, duration, and timestamp.

methods.name: slowlogFreeEntry
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a slowlog entry.

methods.name: slowlogInit
methods.description: Initializes the slowlog system at server startup.

methods.name: slowlogPushEntryIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds a new slowlog entry if the duration exceeds the threshold, maintaining max length.

methods.name: slowlogReset
methods.description: Clears all entries from the slowlog.

methods.name: slowlogCommand
methods.description: Handles the SLOWLOG command with subcommands: get, reset, len.
